up: Find the document with chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5726160' in the docs table. Then identify all distinct compounds that are associated with this document via the compound_records table (linked by doc_id). For each such compound, retrieve its ChEMBL identifier (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), its preferred name (molecule_dictionary.pref_name), and its canonical SMILES (from compound_structures.canonical_smiles). Only include compounds that have a structure entry in compound_structures. Return all resulting rows without any limit.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d INNER JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id INNER JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno INNER JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5726160';
